transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. How can I help you today?

I just don’t care about my painting or the garden anymore, and the things I used to look forward to feel like a burden. My daughter and my primary doctor really pressed me to come in and get evaluated because of how much I've withdrawn lately. I just feel so tired and empty, and I don't know what to do.
Have you lost interest in almost all activities, including things you used to enjoy, most of the time over the last two weeks?

Yes, completely. These days I walk past my easel and the garden beds and feel absolutely nothing, so I just sit in my chair instead. It’s actually been going on for much longer than two weeks—it's been about three months now, ever since my high energy spell ended.
Before this period of low mood and loss of interest, did you have a time where your mood was unusually high or irritable, and you had much more energy or needed less sleep than usual?

Yes, back in the spring, I had a spell where I felt incredibly revved up, touchy, and had an endless amount of energy. I barely slept because my mind was racing with ideas, and I was constantly on the move trying to revamp the community center and start new projects. It was the complete opposite of how I feel now.
How long did that high-energy, irritable period last—was it at least four consecutive days, or longer?

It was much longer than four days, stretching on for several weeks—about a month, I'd say. That whole time in the spring just felt like a continuous blur of being constantly on the go before I finally crashed.
